task: Phase 2d Task 5b -- the difficulty rung's calibration. The value is chosen against this, not after seeing the rung
why_a_calibration_rather_than_a_chosen_v: Two constraints bind one number and pull against each other -- (a5b). The rung must land near
2c's measured difficulty of 40.79 cold iterations per point, and it must fit the 19.8 h left
of the 30 h ceiling at a price that RISES with the difficulty being bought. A third constraint
voids the rung if it is missed: a baseline misclassification rate above a half is the second
cause of a firing interior null, and it invalidates the SUBJECT rather than the estimator.
A value argued for rather than measured would satisfy whichever constraint was discussed last.

the_lever_named_before_any_value.lever: white / sigma -- the noise floor relative to the correlated amplitude
why_not_contrast: parameters = factor x BASE, so one factor multiplies sigma, rho and white together and
white/sigma is constant everywhere on every rung by construction. Measured 2026-09-01, 8
series at N = 630: the same data scaled by 2.5 fits in 23.50 iterations per point against
23.62 unscaled. Amplitude is free, as a concentrated likelihood requires.
why_not_rho: rho in samples is worth about one iteration across a factor of 6.7 -- 23.62 at 9.4 samples,
24.62 at 23.6, 24.75 at 3.5. It is a lever in name only.
why_this_one: The same probe measured white/sigma 0.4 -> 0.8 taking iterations from 23.62 to 28.75 and
seconds from 13.70 to 26.48. And 2c's own fixture -- recoverable, in the tree at
warmstart-spike-harness.py -- runs its HARD regime at white/sigma 0.45-0.71 against 2d's
0.40 everywhere, which is the gap the 40.79-against-24.4 comparison could not localise.

instrument.threads: threadpool_limits(1), the setting every 2d rate is measured under
instrument.rho_held_at: the shipped BASE value, because the probe measured it worth about one iteration
instrument.sigma_held_at: 1.0, with white varied -- so the ladder moves ONE quantity

readings.name: iterations, seconds and misclassification against white/sigma
method: 16 series per setting per family, drawn from the shipped _covariance at sigma = 1.0 and
the shipped rho, varying white alone. Fitted through the shipped fit with the shipped
candidate set. Reports iterations per point, seconds per point, and the fraction of points
whose selected candidate does not carry the true family.
prediction: Iterations rise monotonically with white/sigma and reach 2c's 40.79 somewhere at or above
1.0. Misclassification also rises, because a fainter correlated component is harder to
attribute to a family. The two rise together and the choice is where they cross.
SECONDS RISE FASTER THAN ITERATIONS. Measured at 0.4 -> 0.8: +22% iterations, +93%
seconds. This is the correction filed at Task 0's record and it is what makes the cost
constraint bind before the difficulty constraint does.

reading: The noise floor is not the lever either, and the probe's +5 iterations was a local slope
rather than a trend. The gap to 2c's fixture is then in something neither the amplitude,
nor rho, nor the noise floor explains -- most likely the SIGNAL (2c adds a trend of 0.3
per year to a series of sigma ~1, this field's signal is fitted the same way) or the
regime's parameter RANGE within a cell rather than its level.
ACTION: report and stop. Do NOT run a rung at a difficulty the lever cannot reach, and do
not raise the ladder further hoping -- a third failed lever is a finding about the field
builder, not a reason for a fourth guess.

refuted_from_above.when: misclassification exceeds 0.35 at every setting reaching 35 iterations
reading: Difficulty and separability cannot be bought apart on this construction: every setting
hard enough to be interesting has a baseline close enough to a half that the interior
null is at risk, and a rung there would most likely stop at its own gate.
ACTION: report the trade-off with its numbers and take the decision explicitly rather
than running a rung expected to void itself.

what_would_NOT_refute_anything: A monotone rise that stops short of 40.79 while staying separable. The rung is then run at
the highest affordable, separable setting and its difficulty is REPORTED as what it is --
the question is whether the artifact appears as difficulty rises, not whether one number

what_this_calibration_does_not_establish: Nothing about hysteresis. It measures how hard the fit is, not whether a warm start biases it.
Nothing about the field's spatial structure: it fits independent series with no boundary, no
neighbours and no warm starts, which is why it is minutes rather than hours.
And it is not a rung: no number from it may be quoted as a 2d result.
